title: Sigiriya & Dambulla Day Tour
seoTitle: Sigiriya & Dambulla Day Tour | Lion Rock, Caves & Habarana | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private Cultural Triangle day: climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, Dambulla Cave Temple and Golden Buddha, Habarana village safari, and elephant safari at the eco park.
shortDescription: Sigiriya Lion Rock, Dambulla Cave Temple and Golden Buddha, Habarana village safari, and Habarana elephant safari at the eco park.
overview:
A private full-day journey into Sri Lanka’s Cultural Triangle. Climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, visit Dambulla Cave Temple and the Golden Buddha statue, join a Habarana village safari, and take a Habarana elephant safari at the eco park.
Your chauffeur guide keeps the day flexible for photos and rest. Entrance fees and lunch are not included.

highlights.title: Sigiriya Lion Rock
highlights.description: Climb Sigiriya Lion Rock — water gardens, frescoes, and a summit panorama over the Cultural Triangle. Private pace with time for photos and rest. Entrance is paid on site and is not included.

highlights.title: Dambulla Cave Temple & Golden Buddha
highlights.description: Visit Dambulla Cave Temple and the Golden Buddha statue: ancient murals, cave shrines, and the giant seated Buddha above the hillside entrance.

highlights.title: Habarana Village Safari
highlights.description: A Habarana village safari through countryside lanes, rice fields, and local life — a slower look at rural Sri Lanka between the main sites.

highlights.title: Habarana Elephant Safari (Eco Park)
highlights.description: Habarana elephant safari at the eco park — typically Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park depending on the season. Park tickets are extra and not included.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Colombo, the west coast, or an agreed point — and returns you in the evening. Tell us your hotel when you book so we confirm pickup.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya, Dambulla & Habarana
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup, then a private Cultural Triangle day: climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, visit Dambulla Cave Temple and the Golden Buddha, enjoy a Habarana village safari, and join a Habarana elephant safari at the eco park. Evening return to your hotel.
